title: PlayerSkillMetric
description: One player's reading of one Skill Tree metric under `skill_tree_v1` (ADR-107): regular-season statistics through the build's cutoff week, with the sample behind each value and — when qualified — its competition rank and percentile among qualified players at the same position. DESCRIPTIVE CONTEXT ONLY: read by no model, ranking, tier, pick, trade search or lineup, and never combined into a score. Scoring- and league-independent: one record per player per metric for the whole build. Every population player has an `appearances` record (value = games); a board player who has not appeared has that record alone (state `no_appearances`). What each metric is — label, formula, minimum, cohort rule, limitations — is in `skill_tree_definitions.json`.

through_week.description: The board's cutoff: only regular-season weeks 1..through_week are counted.

position.description: The position the site shows for him; his tree and every peer cohort are this position's.

state.description: ranked: value, rank and percentile. below_minimum: value and sample, no rank. small_cohort: qualified but fewer than 5 qualified players. no_opportunity: denominator 0, no value. not_covered: the source has no reading for him (see reason). unavailable: the source was withheld or failed for this build (see reason). no_appearances: presence record of a player with no games.

value.description: The reading as published (rounded to the definition's decimals; fractions 0-1 for rates and shares). Null exactly for no_opportunity, not_covered and unavailable.

numerator.description: The summed numerator behind a rate or share (for a total, the total itself). Null when the definition has no numerator label (CPOE, Next Gen Stats, combine) or the reading is unavailable.

denominator.description: The sample: attempts, carries, targets, receptions, dropbacks, team totals in his games, or the Next Gen Stats volume. Null for totals, combine and unavailable readings.

rank.description: Competition rank (1, 2, 2, 4) within the cohort in the metric's direction (lower-is-better metrics rank the lowest first; neutral metrics rank the highest value first, as position not merit). Null unless state is ranked.

percentile.description: 100 × (players strictly behind + (ties − 1) / 2) ÷ (cohort − 1), direction-adjusted, one decimal. Null unless state is ranked.

cohort_size.description: Qualified players this reading was ranked among (for the combine, testers at his combine position since 2000). Null unless state is ranked or small_cohort.

games.description: His games played through the cutoff (stats row or offensive snap), repeated on each record.

source_season.description: The combine year for `combine_forty`; null otherwise.

reason.description: Why a reading is not_covered or unavailable (a code from ros_build_metadata.skill_tree.reasons), or `tested_as:<POS>` when a combine time is ranked among another combine position's testers. Null otherwise.
